caption: The drawing, executed in grayscale pencil on a beige-toned paper, depicts three distinct objects within a single rectangular border. On the left side, there is a tall, upright object composed of a long, narrow handle or shaft that culminates in a wide, conical base, resembling a bell or a similarly shaped vessel. Perched atop this handle is a metal clamp or clip with a pair of symmetrical, curved hooks emerging from either end. To the right of this upright object, there is a separate depiction of the clamp and hooks, shown alone and floating in space, illustrating the same shape without the handle and base. The hooks are prominently curved, and the clamp is rendered with shading to indicate its metallic texture. A faint diagonal line runs behind the upright object, providing a sense of depth. Near the lower right corner of the border, the name "Mildred Ford" is signed in small, neat writing.
title: Rush Light Stand
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
